description: Click a mouse button on the remote computer of the open session. Default is press and release. x and y are pixels of the remote picture; pass from_screenshot: true when they were read from a reduced jrd_remote_screenshot picture. Use `press_only` / `release_only` for drag-style interactions. Requires an open session where this computer is the viewer.

from_screenshot.description: Set true when x and y were read from the last jrd_remote_screenshot picture. They are scaled to the remote screen for you.

press_only.description: Send only mouse-down (start of a drag). Default false.

release_only.description: Send only mouse-up (end of a drag). Default false.

x.description: Optional X coord — if omitted, click at current cursor position.

y.description: Optional Y coord — if omitted, click at current cursor position.

name: jrd_mouse_click
